hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the two-parameter template T(a,b) by substituting the listed ordered argument values for (a,b). The two observed members are the two possible ordered assignments of the distinct declared symbols i and j to the two slots of T.
required_assumptions: T is the same unevaluated two-argument function symbol in both members
a and b range over the declared symbols i and j
hypotheses.rationale: Both observed expressions are applications of the same two-argument symbol T to the same set of symbols {i,j}; they differ only by argument order. A two-parameter template captures that shared application structure without asserting algebraic equality between T(i,j) and T(j,i).
